name: Uizard
tagline: Uizard transforms hand-drawn wireframe sketches, screenshots, or text descriptions into interactive app prototypes in minutes. Its AI can generate a multi-screen app mockup from a plain-language brief, which designers then refine and share with stakeholders for feedback. Product managers and non-designers use Uizard to communicate product ideas visually before any engineering work begins.
